description: ManyWells implements a steady-state drift-flux simulator for vertical oil and gas wells, representing oil and water as one liquid phase. It includes inflow and choke boundaries, calibration, closed-loop examples and scripts for synthetic data generation. The provider is Solution Seeker AS. Coverage: The model is generic; well geometry and operating boundaries are inputs. It is not a measured regional well inventory. Access: A public repository contains model documentation and installation instructions. No source archive or dependencies were downloaded. Licence and cost: The repository applies CC-BY-NC-4.0 to both code and datasets, restricting commercial reuse. Limitations: This is a simplified steady-state model associated with a research publication. Its empirical adequacy and independent reuse were not established. For simulation it supports synthetic production-data generation, flow prediction and parameter-sensitivity experiments. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
